Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses CLIR-MS to identify RNA-protein cross-links. While TiO2 is typically used for phosphoproteomics (hence the PPA:0000292 label), here it is explicitly used to enrich peptide-RNA adducts. The RNA itself is isotope-labeled (13C), but the protein is not labeled for quantification. The primary goal is site-specific mapping of cross-links, requiring PTM-aware search parameters for RNA adducts.
